name: Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
definition: The **Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension** is $$\mathrm{NCTD}^{+p}(\mathcal H)\bydef\max_{S\subseteq\mathcal X}\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S}),$$ where each teacher is required to use only positive examples of its target concept.
graph_summary: Largest positive no-clashing teaching dimension attained by a coordinate projection.
description: The projection-monotonic closure of positive no-clashing teaching dimension.
origin_references: Database-defined projection closure of the positive no-clashing model of \cite{KSZ2019}.

monotonic.proof: For every coordinate set S, a trace of a subfamily is a subfamily of the corresponding trace. Positive no-clashing teaching dimension is subfamily-monotonic, and taking maxima preserves the inequality.

p_monotonic.proof: Every projection of a projection of H is already a projection of H, so the maximum over traces cannot increase after projection.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioned fibre is a subfamily followed by a projection, so doubly monotonicity implies conditioning monotonicity.

doubly_monotonic.proof: The preceding subfamily and projection arguments establish both required forms.
